description: Read-only ranked keyword search across approved Nebula KB sections. Use when you have a query; use nebula_list to browse without ranking, nebula_section for one exact path, nebula_overview for a summary. Returns query, results[{path,score,record}], total, offset, limit, nextOffset.

offset.description: Number of ranked hits to skip (default 0)

query.description: Search words, e.g. "AI SEO for manufacturers"

name: nebula_search
title: Search Nebula knowledge
